source: docs/brand.md section 5 (colour) and section 6 (type). Edit here, then run `make tokens`.

color.name: cue
color.use: Live/next indicators, icon tape, wordmark dot. Non-text only on light.

color.name: cueText
color.use: Text in the accent and chord symbols.

color.name: ground
color.use: Window and live view background (paper / stage).

color.name: controlBorder
color.use: Outline of secondary buttons, chips, steppers; 3:1 with Increase Contrast.

color.name: played
color.use: Played-song progress dots in the live header.

color.name: lineStrong
color.use: Icon greys, piano black keys, dashed drop zones (not state indicators).

color.name: indicatorOff
color.use: Off state of indicators: pending progress dots, unrated stars (3:1 on ground).
